Wear clothes that fit your body, keep your shoes and clothing clean, invest in timeless pieces, choose quality over gimmicks, and understand that understated almost always looks more sophisticated. Looking classy isn’t about getting everybody to notice what you’re wearing—it’s about looking so effortlessly put together that they notice you.
